links.outcome: Performance (geometric mean) of candidate models versus the GRACE score on the same dataset
links.effect: The rule-based approach outperformed the GRACE model's performance while providing a high level of trust. No numeric results are given in the abstract.
links.quote: It provides a high level of trust in the respective operation while outperformed the GRACE model's performance, enhancing the required physicians' acceptance.

unlisted_practices: Combined trust and performance assessment of ML models using stability (robustness), 95% CI of geometric mean (confidence), and interpretability checked against clinical evidence

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an evaluation framework assessing trust (robustness, confidence intervals, interpretability) alongside performance for predictive risk models on a retrospective cardiovascular cohort.
